title: Version 5 Blueprint Schema Annotation Protocol
description: Metadata required on canonical version-5 module and behavioral-source schemas so schema files define authoring and enforcement links.

schema-shape.description: Validate required fields, values, and unknown-field rejection through the selected version 5 JSON Schema.
schema-shape.creation: Render each module and behavioral-source document from its concrete schema and reject values outside that schema before graph construction.
schema-shape.template: Render every module and behavioral source from its concrete schema.

enforcement.note: The version 5 JSON Schemas are the structural acceptance component.

canonical-id.description: Validate module, behavioral-source, source-interface, and export IDs and namespaces.
canonical-id.creation: Use the canonical module, source, source-interface, or export namespace required by the concrete schema.
canonical-id.template: Use example-skill, example-skill.source.gateway, and example-skill.interface.run in the example graph.

enforcement.note: The interface-ID validator enforces the unified namespaces.

root-directory-id.description: Require each skill module ID to equal its skill directory name.
root-directory-id.creation: Name blueprint.yaml with the exact module directory ID.

enforcement.note: Repository graph loading enforces module-directory identity.

version-pin.description: Require positive versions and exact edge-to-target version matches.
version-pin.creation: Use positive versions and pin every declared source or interface edge to the target version.

enforcement.note: Relationship validation checks exact target versions.

gateway-file.description: Require every node to name an existing regular whole-file gateway inside its ownership scope.
gateway-file.creation: Name one file relative to the node ownership root and include it in the node content patterns.
gateway-file.template: Create each gateway before validating the example graph.

enforcement.note: Graph and source validation require an existing regular gateway included in content.

content-files.description: Resolve every content regex to the files in its node ownership scope and require the gateway to match.
content-files.creation: Use node-relative regular expressions that match the node's complete owned file set.
content-files.template: Each example content list matches its gateway and any additional directly owned files.

enforcement.note: Graph and source validation compile content expressions and require gateway inclusion.

content-exclusive.description: Require each directly owned content file to belong to exactly one node.
content-exclusive.creation: Partition direct ownership between a module and its contained behavioral sources without overlapping matches.
content-exclusive.template: Contained sources own their implementation files and the module owns the residual files.

enforcement.note: Repository graph validation rejects overlapping direct ownership.

content-non-symlink.description: Require gateways and directly owned content to be regular files without symlink traversal.
content-non-symlink.creation: Use regular files under the node ownership root and reject symlink components, endpoints, and non-regular files.
content-non-symlink.template: The example graph uses regular gateway and content files.

enforcement.note: Graph and source validation reject unsafe runtime file paths.

relationship-edge.description: Resolve containment, source dependency, private-interface, export, and contract-reference edges.
relationship-edge.creation: Declare only canonical, version-pinned graph edges with the required locator or target interface.
relationship-edge.template: The example module contains one source and exports one of its interfaces.

enforcement.note: Relationship and graph validation reject unresolved, duplicate, unauthorized, and cyclic edges.

access-control.description: Validate immediate-caller access for unrestricted, subtree-allowlisted, and owner-private module surfaces.
access-control.creation: Set allow_all_modules or enumerate caller module roots whose registered descendants are admitted; an empty false allowlist admits only the owner.
access-control.template: The example export chooses one explicit access policy.

enforcement.note: Graph validation enforces module export access and private-interface ownership.

runtime-dependency.description: Validate source platform support and where each dependency applies through the reachable required interface closure.
runtime-dependency.creation: State source support explicitly, list non-stdlib dependencies, and never claim a platform absent from a required interface.
runtime-dependency.template: The example declares its support and an empty dependency list.

enforcement.note: Repository graph validation checks source and required interface platform compatibility.

filesystem-ownership.description: Validate module filesystem ownership and authorized generic interface readers.
filesystem-ownership.creation: Give each writable path one module owner and enumerate authorized source or export interfaces.
filesystem-ownership.template: The example declares no owned filesystem paths.

enforcement.note: Source and graph validation enforce ownership, reader authorization, and overlap rules.

behavioral-source-edge.description: Require behavioral-source dependency targets, exact versions, locators, and consumer-local reasons.
behavioral-source-edge.creation: Use a version-pinned behavioral-source blueprint locator and state the consumer-local reason.
behavioral-source-edge.template: The example source declares its direct source dependencies.

enforcement.note: Relationship validation resolves and types direct source dependencies.

direct-io-description.description: Validate source-interface direct I/O as complete semantic evidence without treating it as subsystem confinement.
direct-io-description.creation: Describe immediate source-interface reads, writes, and network actions without copying transitive tool I/O.
direct-io-description.template: The example uses empty direct-I/O arrays.

enforcement.note: The source-owned direct-I/O schema validates the canonical evidence shape.

dispatcher-argv-pattern.description: Validate process-binding argv patterns without treating them as subsystem confinement.
dispatcher-argv-pattern.creation: Declare only caller-visible accepted argument patterns under the source interface process binding.
dispatcher-argv-pattern.template: The example process binding declares only its accepted argv grammar.

enforcement.note: The process-binding schema validates the declared pattern shape.

generated-contract-block.description: Require generated SKILL.md contract and interface blocks to match the discoverable module and its exports.
generated-contract-block.creation: Generate both blocks from the module and source declarations; do not hand-maintain them.
generated-contract-block.template: The example discoverable module includes both generated marker blocks.

enforcement.note: Blueprint and skill-body validation compare generated blocks with the unified graph.

interface-body-use.description: Require behavioral-source bodies to use declared source interfaces or module exports.
interface-body-use.creation: Name declared generic interface IDs and never invoke another module through an implementation path.
interface-body-use.template: The example body contains no undeclared interface reference.

enforcement.note: Dependency validation checks source bodies against declared generic interface uses.

relationship-matrix.description: Allow only the declared relation types between modules and behavioral sources.
relationship-matrix.creation: Use x-famulus.relationship_matrix as the complete node-relation policy.
relationship-matrix.template: The example uses containment, source dependency, private-interface, and export relations only.

enforcement.note: Graph validation rejects relation and target-kind combinations outside the matrix.

nested-topology.description: Require explicit direct-child registration with module-root-relative canonical blueprint.yaml locators.
nested-topology.creation: Declare children explicitly, including an empty mapping, and locate each direct child from its parent module root.
nested-topology.template: The example module declares an explicit children mapping.

enforcement.note: The canonical module schema and repository graph enforce closed registration and parent-child reconciliation.

namespace-export.description: Require each namespace route to pin one direct child, an access filter, and exactly one all or only surface.
namespace-export.creation: Declare namespace_exports explicitly and use closed all or nonempty exact-interface only surfaces.
namespace-export.template: The example module declares an explicit namespace_exports mapping.

enforcement.note: The canonical module schema and authorization resolver reject malformed surfaces and enforce attenuation.

facade-export.description: Require each export to be exactly one source export or one exact facade target and version.
facade-export.creation: Choose source_interface or facade_interface and never mix the two forms.
facade-export.template: Each example export selects one closed export form.

enforcement.note: The canonical module schema and repository graph enforce the source-or-facade choice and prove the target.

relative-caller.description: Accept only exact global module IDs or leading-dot relative module references with a nonempty suffix.
relative-caller.creation: Use a globally unique module ID or a relative reference such as ._rtx or ..parser.
relative-caller.template: Caller allowlists use exact global or leading-dot relative references.

enforcement.note: The common schema rejects malformed references and the repository graph resolves them through certified topology.

canonical-pooled-review.description: Treat pooled blueprint review as a certificate-backed generated projection rather than graph authority.
canonical-pooled-review.creation: Render the review from the validated graph and current node certificates.
canonical-pooled-review.template: Generated review files remain outside authored graph inputs.

enforcement.note: Pooled-review validation checks the projection against the current graph and certificates.
